content.text: {"route":"gap","reason":"The record has material gaps. There are no statements from comparators or from the officials who handled the transfer request, and no evidence on how similarly situated employees were treated. The accommodation claim is thin: no interactive-process documentation, no analysis of the ergonomic chair and workstation requests (the decision focuses only on transfer), and no inquiry into other vacancies or duty stations. The reprisal basis is unclear because the cited prior EEO activity (a 2019 complaint) postdates the 2018 events, and nothing addresses whether the deciding officials knew of it. Management's response to the hostile-work-environment claim rests only on S1's and C1's statements. The administrative leave decision is not backed by documentation of who was consulted, the safety assessment, or how comparable posts were handled. The record also has date inconsistencies, such as the transfer request dates and the complaint chronology, that are not reconciled."}
